designDetails.surface: Keep the armored head shield, ribbed thorax, tendon channels, limb joints and segmented tail readable through value and material contrast. The albino surface is newly authored, never a white filter over base frames.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless shielded head, one massive low thorax, exactly four weight-bearing limbs and one continuous tail. No Queen chest arms, carried equipment or clothing.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 40 poses; shield, four limbs and full tail remain inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit enemy-009's single all-profile scale and front-heavy shield/thorax proportions. Base art remains pending final visual acceptance, so future generation must independently re-certify all five sheets.
designDetails.root: Inherit the base thorax center projected to the support floor, using planted limbs or terminal body contact. Shield and tail extents never redefine root x.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, hive resin, text or grid.
